title: CV Frontmatter
description: YAML frontmatter schema for markdown CV files in markdown-source/

$schema.description: JSON Schema path for IDE autocomplete

label.description: Display name in the language switcher

default.description: Set to true for the default language

title.description: Browser tab title and social preview title

description.description: Meta description for SEO and social previews

ogImage.description: Path to social preview image in public/

siteUrl.description: Public site URL for absolute og:image and og:url (default language file only)
